definitions.explanation: A bag used to carry purchased goods, whether a reusable bag brought from home or a bag provided at a store.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}を{持|も}っていく。
{買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}が{重|おも}くて{手|て}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: The shopping bag is so heavy my hands hurt.

examples.japanese: レジ{袋|ぶくろ}が{有料|ゆうりょう}になったので、{買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}を{忘|わす}れないようにしている。
examples.english: Since plastic bags became paid, I make sure not to forget my shopping bag.

notes:
Compound of {買|か}い{物|もの} (shopping) and {袋|ぶくろ} (bag). Since Japan made plastic bags (レジ{袋|ぶくろ}) paid at stores in 2020, the word {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ} is now commonly associated with reusable bags (エコバッグ) that shoppers bring themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}を{持参|じさん}する: to bring one's own shopping bag
- {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}に{入|い}れる: to put in a shopping bag
- {買|か}い{物袋|ものぶくろ}を{忘|わす}れる: to forget one's shopping bag

RELATED WORDS:
- レジ{袋|ぶくろ}: plastic bag (at checkout) — the disposable bag provided at the register
- エコバッグ: reusable bag; eco bag — a loanword commonly used for reusable shopping bags
- {紙袋|かみぶくろ}: paper bag
